Definition: A text field with a list of choices that opens below it. A person can pick a choice from the list or type in the field.
One of the pieces of text in a combo box's list, such as "Medium" in a list of sizes.
A choice's place in the list. The first choice has index 0, the second has index 1, and so on. An index of -1 means nothing is chosen.
Words shown in an empty field, such as "Choose a size", that tell a person what to do. They go away once there is text in the field.
Showing only the choices that start with the text a person has typed. A combo box ignores upper and lower case when it narrows.
An object that a control tells when something happens. A ComboBoxListener is told when a person picks a different choice.
